payload.rebuttal: fixed: The test tracked create_network/remove_network calls but never recorded calls to host_probe_ports, assert_host_is_unreachable, or package(), so a version that skipped the whole probe body and let package() raise an AssertionError still returned exit 2 through main's generic except-Exception handler, passing the old assertions by coincidence. I rewrote the fakes for host_probe_ports, assert_host_is_unreachable, and package to append their own name to the shared calls list, then asserted the full ordered sequence (names == expected_names) instead of only checking the two network calls. I confirmed this kills the named mutant: applying the exact edit from the finding (collapsing the try body down to just runtime.create_network(network)) now fails with 'remove_network != host_probe_ports' at the sequence comparison, then reverted the mutant and reran clean.
